about: Buyer questions, each with the findings that answer it (by metric name). Written from the metric definitions before any model run. Most questions are worded the way a buyer would ask, not with the metric's label, which is what separates a semantic ranking from keyword overlap; a few (q14, q12) share words with a label on purpose.

questions.q: Can they pay their bills over the next few months?
Are they carrying too much leverage?
Do they still make money on each unit they sell?
How dependent are we on this vendor?
If they fail, could we switch to someone else quickly?
How long do they take to deliver an order?
Are there any compliance or legal red flags?
Has anything material happened at the company recently, like a restructuring or an executive leaving?
Could buying from them break US Treasury rules?
Is there a backup vendor we could use?
What share of our category spend goes to them?
Are they on a government blacklist?
Would trouble at this supplier stall our production for months?
